notes.title: Major Update: A Friendlier New Player Experience 🐾✨
notes.notes:
Dear Guardians,

We are excited to announce that a major update for Cat Guardians is now officially live!

Whether you’re a new player just starting your adventure or a seasoned defender of the Meowks Planet, this update is designed to bring you a smoother and more exhilarating gameplay experience! 🎉
Here are the full details of the update:


[h1]🐾 Update Highlights: Major New Player Guidance Upgrades![/h1]
[h2]🎮Two Modes Optimized: Challenge & Survival, Friendlier and Easier to Pick Up![/h2]

     [h3]Survival Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a detailed tutorial for [b]the first 5 days[/b], with step-by-step guidance to help you quickly understand the core mechanics of survival gameplay.
[*] Introduced helpful tips and increased resource support to ensure a stress-free start for new players. No need to worry—everything is explained, and you'll be fully equipped to defend your cat homeland!
[/list]

In Survival Mode, we’ve introduced a thoughtful tutorial designed to make it much easier for new players to get started! 
With the addition of tutorial prompts and extra resource support, you’ll now enjoy a safer and more structured beginning to your journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/1b25d97f8cf9318cfe44f3d3ed29f6e5ebbf6b10.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/7d46bb944105185f5f213033a0618d9d8abe6f96.jpg[/img]



     [h3]Challenge Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved guidance with clearer, more straightforward prompts to help new players quickly grasp cards and battle strategies.
[*] Added clear objective indicators, making your adventure smoother and more rewarding!
[/list]

To help players get started with Challenge Mode more quickly, we’ve optimized the level objective indicators. 
Now, it’s easier than ever to understand how to build your deck and achieve your goals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/ad4022258e68f1142b56f3f5b37152970bf18629.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/c45bec5a1aca4c2c5a48c081a87467b177d7c3bc.jpg[/img]




[h2]⚔️Difficulty Curve Adjustments: Immersive Battle Experience![/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve fine-tuned the difficulty curve for both Survival and Challenge modes, ensuring that every level feels exhilarating—challenging yet fun.
[*] Experience smoother battle pacing and endless possibilities for card strategy, fully immersing yourself in the world of Cat Guardian!
[/list]

We’ve made comprehensive adjustments to the difficulty curve! Now, you’ll enjoy a smoother combat flow while indulging in the immersive thrill of strategic battles.




[h2]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Fixed a series of bugs related to the Tree of Hope.
[*] Resolved the infinite building duplication bug.
[*] Fixed the quick interaction issue with cat cards.
[*] Addressed the bug affecting zombie damage values caused by the Toxic Bomb series.
[*] Fixed the issue where cat cards would randomly disappear in Challenge Mode.
[*] Corrected the pollution index display error.
[*] Fixed the issue where the laboratory could not generate Cat Elixir.
[*] Resolved the planting bug during extreme heat conditions.
[*] Fixed a series of cat card-related bugs.
[*] Resolved the population counter bug.
[*] Fixed several save/load bugs, optimized loading logic, and improved loading speeds.
[*] Adjusted the effect of blizzards on weapon card attack power to 50%.
[*] Added hover tooltips for the four shop buttons to display their type names.
[*] Adjusted material prices in the shop.
[*] Modified the explosion radius of self-destructing zombies.
[/olist]

With these fixes and improvements, your gameplay will be smoother, more balanced, and free of some pesky issues! 🎉



[h1]❤️Finally, Thank You![/h1]
We sincerely thank every one of you for your support and feedback—
it’s your input that drives us to continuously improve the game! 
If you enjoy this update, feel free to leave a comment or share your thoughts in the community. 
And of course, if you have more suggestions, we’re always here to listen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/42f24209cb5461a10ef1ea03f686f503951847c3.png[/img]


The newly optimized Cat Guardian is ready for you! 
Whether it’s the new tutorials or the smooth battle experience, everything is waiting for you to explore. 

[h3]Update your game now and join the all-new adventure in Cat Guardians! 🐾💖[/h3]

[b]—Your Meowks Planet needs you![/b]



Good luck, Guardian!
The Cat Guardian Dev Team

notes.title: Cat Guardian: First Round of Friends and Family Playtest Begins!

In this testing phase, we are fortunate to have invited some core players who have enthusiastically participated and provided invaluable feedback. The dev team has greatly benefited from these contributions and is deeply grateful for all the participants' efforts.

We extend our heartfelt thanks to all those involved in the friends and family test! Your support and suggestions are the driving force behind our progress, allowing us to continually refine Cat Guardian and strive to deliver an even more exciting gaming experience.

Once again, thank you all for your support and enthusiasm. Let's look forward to more playtest/demo  together!

Guard the Cats, Battle On!
